This helps government officials at all levels explore and assess key government initiatives for any geographic level, at any time period. The DISHA Dashboard helps Members of Parliament (MPs), Members of Legislative Assembly (MLAs), and District Officials track the performance of all major flagship schemes in their districts and constituencies. Data management for DISHA Project, responding to user queries, database maintenance, and report generation. Analyzed large datasets to identify trends, patterns and correlations for business insights. Worked on multiple Government of India domain schemes including healthcare, banking, finance, and citizen service delivery, ensuring accurate data management and process implementation. Implemented data privacy controls to protect PHI (Protected Health Information) in accordance with HIPAA regulations for national health schemes governed by NHA and WHO guidelines. Collaborated with functional, security, and compliance teams to identify, assess, and mitigate HIPAA-related risks across healthcare data workflows. Developed dashboards with POWER BI to monitor key performance indicators. Gathered requirements from stakeholders (All government ministry schemes) to design data models and reports. Built visualizations that enabled users to quickly interpret results from complex analyses.

experience.company: Akal Information System Pvt Ltd, New Delhi
responsibilities: Supported production deployments and post-release validation of CDC processes, including backfilling data and reinitializing journals when required. Analyzed requirements and designed database schemas for applications. Collaborated closely with project managers, designers, and other developers in order to complete tasks efficiently and effectively. Generated reports from databases using SQL queries. Created SQL Server Integration Services packages for incremental and full loads of data from various sources. Developed ETL packages to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources into a data warehouse. Involved in creating database objects such as tables, views, indexes based on business requirements. Optimized existing queries for better performance using SQL query tuning techniques. Designed complex reports using SQL Server Reporting Services. Integrated multiple data sources into one unified view using views or joins in SQL queries. Developed ETL processes using SSIS packages for loading data from various sources into a data warehouse environment. Generated ad hoc reports upon request from stakeholders utilizing Microsoft Excel Pivot Tables or Access Queries.

Development and maintenance of data replication packages, troubleshooting database issues, and report generation. Developed and implemented data warehouse models for various reporting requirements using SQL Server 2008, 2012, 2014. Configured and managed journalizing (Simple and Consistent CDC) using ODI Knowledge Modules, handled subscription management, and ensured data consistency across multiple transport databases while processing high-volume transactional data. Designed and implemented Change Data Capture (CDC) in ODI 11g and 12c to capture incremental changes (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) from source transport systems (vehicle registration, license, permit data) and load them into the central data warehouse, ensuring near real-time data availability. Created SSIS packages to extract, transform and load data from multiple sources into the Data Warehouse. Worked with Business Intelligence tools such as Tableau and Power BI for creating interactive dashboards. Maintained documentation related to all aspects of Database Design and Development activities like ER diagrams, DDL scripts. Investigated issues reported by end users related to data quality and accuracy within the Data Warehouse environment.
